name: Selection Sort
code:
# Selection Sort (RISC-V assembly)
# Sorts the array in place: a[0] .. a[n-1]
#
# a0 = base address of the array
# a1 = number of elements n
# t0 = i, t1 = j, t2 = index of the smallest element seen so far

    li a0, 0x0          # base address of the array
    li a1, 0xA          # n = 10 elements
    addi t3, a1, -1     # t3 = n - 1
    li t0, 0x0          # i = 0

outer:                        # for i = 0 .. n-2
    bge t0, t3, done          # i >= n-1 -> finished
    mv  t2, t0                # min_index = i
    addi t1, t0, 0x1          # j = i + 1

inner:                        # for j = i+1 .. n-1
    bge t1, a1, endinner      # j >= n -> put the minimum in place
    slli t4, t1, 0x2          # t4 = j * 4
    add t4, a0, t4            # t4 = &a[j]
    lw  t5, 0x0(t4)           # t5 = a[j]
    slli t4, t2, 0x2          # t4 = min_index * 4
    add t4, a0, t4            # t4 = &a[min_index]
    lw  t6, 0x0(t4)           # t6 = a[min_index]
    bge t5, t6, notless       # a[j] >= a[min_index] -> keep the minimum
    mv  t2, t1                # min_index = j
notless:
    addi t1, t1, 0x1          # j++
    j inner

endinner:                     # swap a[i] and a[min_index]
    slli t4, t0, 0x2
    add t4, a0, t4            # t4 = &a[i]
    lw  t6, 0x0(t4)           # t6 = a[i]
    slli t4, t2, 0x2
    add t4, a0, t4            # t4 = &a[min_index]
    lw  t5, 0x0(t4)           # t5 = a[min_index]
    sw  t6, 0x0(t4)           # a[min_index] = a[i]
    slli t4, t0, 0x2
    add t4, a0, t4            # t4 = &a[i]
    sw  t5, 0x0(t4)           # a[i] = a[min_index]
    addi t0, t0, 0x1          # i++
    j outer

done:                         # the array in memory is now sorted
